title: Design: Tapping a deposit-held Bill To on a phone shows the toast
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as a user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have (set up by an Admin) a new open work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A, with a $10.00 deposit taken on it and not reversed, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p3-12-after-phone-tap.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Tap Show Details if the details are hidden.
  3. Tap the Bill To value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The customer card shows Bill To.

Step 3:

  • A red toast spanning the screen width shows the deposit message; no Open Deposits button.
  • Nothing depends on hovering.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-N3: “Users who cannot change the Bill To get M1 or M4 as an error toast on click or tap, with no button.”
  • S5-R5: “Clicking or tapping that field shows M1 as an error toast with an "Open Deposits" button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Phone, tap" (This build).

  • “A tap never depends on a hover.”
